Definition: adverb from G4012; all around, i.e. (as an adjective) circumjacent:--round about.
BiblicalUsage: Perix means round about, all around. After the apostles' signs in Jerusalem, a multitude came from the cities round about, bringing sick people and those vexed with unclean spirits, and they were all healed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the healing did not stop at the city wall: the good news drew people in from every town around, and none who came went away unhealed.
